findings.problem: A fresh Python3.11 venv may already contain pinned pip24.0. Pip install reports omit already-satisfied packages, but the validator requires all75 second-step packages, so a matching installed runtime can fail its wheel-provenance requirement.
findings.required_resolution: Force reinstall every pinned package only inside the newly owned isolated venv, or explicitly bind bootstrap wheel provenance separately; add meaningful fixture coverage for already-satisfied pip.

findings.problem: Default SIGTERM/SIGHUP terminate the installer without raising into BaseException handling. Its pip process runs in a new session and can survive while failure receipt is omitted.
findings.required_resolution: Scoped TERM/HUP handlers must raise into owned-session cleanup and consumed-failure preservation and restore prior handlers afterward; cover both signals.
